lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mg14Fe2 (reduced formula LiMg7Fe) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Fe and Li are each coordinated by 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 geometric neighbors with mixed Mg, Li, and Fe content, spanning neighbor distances of 2.99–3.33 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations among 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, though these patterns do not assert an exclusive sharing type.
